1.t: By the Sky and the Night-Visitant (therein);-

2.t: And what will explain to thee what the Night-Visitant is?-

3.t: (It is) the Star of piercing brightness;-

4.t: There is no soul but has a protector over it.

5.t: Now let man but think from what he is created!

6.t: He is created from a drop emitted-

7.t: Proceeding from between the backbone and the ribs:

8.t: Surely (Allah) is able to bring him back (to life)!

9.t: The Day that (all) things secret will be tested,

10.t: (Man) will have no power, and no helper.

11.t: By the Firmament which returns (in its round),

12.t: And by the Earth which opens out (for the gushing of springs or the sprouting of vegetation),-

13.t: Behold this is the Word that distinguishes (Good from Evil):

14.t: It is not a thing for amusement.

15.t: As for them, they are but plotting a scheme,

16.t: And I am planning a scheme.

17.t: Therefore grant a delay to the Unbelievers: Give respite to them gently (for awhile).
